the use of microgranules is a promising way to enhance the growth of inoculated bacteria, but that this approach should be used in combination with other strategies to improve the inoculum efficiency.

The main takeaway from our work is that
location of cells in soil is an important factor in competition between bacteria, especially when the inoculated cells are located at the interface between the substrate and soil.
the location of the inoculant cells and the amendment in soil can have a strong effect on the growth of inoculated bacteria and the efficiency of inoculation.
the location of the inoculant and the carbon amendment in the soil is a key factor to enhance the growth of inoculated bacterial cells.
